$comment: Acceptance criteria for GitHub issue #25 -- get_constraints must stop reporting DEFINED while dropping decisions it could not read (ADR-003 rule 6). The command checks assert the behaviour at both ends of the dominance rule, not just that the code changed.

criteria.target: REPO_GOVERNOR_ADR_DIR=conformance/fixtures/adrs-dominated ./adapters/adr query architecture get_constraints id=x | jq -e '.value.state == "UNKNOWN" and .unknown.reason == "ARCHITECTURE_PARTIALLY_READ" and .unknown.blocking == true'

REPO_GOVERNOR_ADR_DIR=conformance/fixtures/adrs-minority ./adapters/adr query architecture get_constraints id=x | jq -e '.value.state == "DEFINED" and .unknown.reason == "STATUS_UNSTATED" and .unknown.blocking == false'
./adapters/adr query architecture get_constraints id=x | jq -e '.unknown == null'
